description: Implement Proposal Engine v2 based on spec at dispatch/specs/proposal-engine-v2-spec.md. Replace bin/proposal-engine.sh with new version. Must: (1) Scan all 6 idea sources (audit gaps, goal alignment, pattern recognition, codebase analysis, self-improvement, vault integration). (2) Generate multi-task proposals with full task breakdowns. (3) Auto-approve and auto-dispatch non-destructive proposals via dispatch.sh add with proper dependency chains. (4) Queue destructive/high-risk proposals for human review. (5) Track proposal outcomes in dispatch/proposal-state.json (proposed→dispatched→completed with success/fail). (6) Emit feed events for each proposal generated, approved, dispatched. (7) Close the feedback loop: completed proposals inform future proposal generation. (8) Cap at 3 active large proposals to prevent overload. Write to bin/proposal-engine-v2.sh.
